pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark brown polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients. Morphology ranges from complex star-shaped patches on the mid-neck to smaller, more rounded shapes on the posterior flank. Spatial area reduces drastically towards the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-toned pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes demonstrate high connectivity. Pixel thickness varies, with wider channels between large cervical patches and significantly thinner boundaries on the lower torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D contour along the dorsal neck. The mane presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the distal background.
